race.comment: FRENCH SOUL (2) looks close to a win and ready for the mile again. Had one start at the trip at the end of first campaign and may well have gone over the top. Has been knocking on the door in two runs this time in and looks ready for the extra ground now. DON TURBOAS (1) was a maiden winner two back then ran on hard and just missed at this trip last time. Looks the one they have to beat. THEM'S THE BREAKS (11) has a wide draw but is ready to win and will take some beating. THE LITTLE BAY (7) is better than the last run when sixth over 1600m at this track. Can improve sharply. GOLD TIANNA (4) lightly raced gelding who progressed nicely last start with a win by a nose over 1380m at this track. Has the big claim and can go on with it.
